question: In what form and where is this vital principle said to be situated within living beings?
premises: The principle is described as breath-filled air.
It is situated in all beings.
Its presence is universal among living beings.
inference: Therefore this principle abides as the breath-filled air present in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement of saṃsthitam with vāyuḥ is irregular in form.
plain_english: As the breath-filled air, it is situated in all living beings.
